battle.name: 岐溝關之戰
battle.theater: 涿州西南岐溝關巨馬河畔
battle.brief: 雍熙三年（986）五月，宋太宗北伐的東路軍在攻下涿州後被耶律休哥切斷糧道，軍中爭功再攻涿州，撤退時遭騎兵追上，於岐溝關全軍潰敗。卡面的秦連弩代表弩機蓄力、足踏連發的傳統：當年宋軍手上是步弩與神臂弓，弓弩齊射仍擋不住追擊與斷糧，決定勝負的其實是糧秣、體力與行伍。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是北宋雍熙三年（986）北伐與遼朝反擊之間的決定性遭遇，交戰地帶在今河北涿州、定興一線，屬燕雲十六州南緣的中段戰場。北宋一方由東京開封出發，兵分三路：東路由天平軍節度使曹彬任幽州道行營前軍馬步水陸都部署，河陽三城節度使崔彥進副之，侍衛親軍馬軍司都指揮使、彰化軍節度使米信與沙洲觀察使杜彥圭自雄州出發；中路由侍衛親軍步軍司都指揮使、靜難軍節度使田重進任定州路都部署，出飛狐；西路以檢校太師、忠武軍節度使潘美與雲州觀察使楊業出雁門關，攻雲、應、朔三州。遼朝一方以南京留守耶律休哥當曹彬之師，耶律斜軫（色珍）為都統當潘美等，林牙勤德率兵守平州南岸作預備，遼聖宗與母親蕭氏率中軍駐駝羅口、屯涿州東一帶，與各路遼軍遙相策應。遼軍在同一年裡還把河北的城邑反覆掃過一遍，岐溝關的潰軍只是這條線上的一環。兩邊的指揮體系都存在結構性問題：宋軍三路分屬不同行營、互不隸屬，名義上的會戰要等各路自行打通；遼軍則以南京留守總攝南面，聖宗與蕭氏居中樞，諸將各統一軍，可以在同一條戰線上互相牽制。
countriesEn: This war was the decisive collision between the Yongxi northern expedition of 986 and Liao's counter-stroke, fought along the line of Zhuozhou and Dingxing in today's Hebei, the middle sector of the southern edge of the Sixteen Prefectures. Liao also swept through the towns of Hebei more than once in that same year, and the routed army at Qigou Pass was only one link in that line. On the Song side the armies left the eastern capital, Kaifeng, in three columns. The eastern column was led by Cao Bin, military governor of Tianping and overall commander of the forward cavalry, infantry and naval forces of the Youzhou circuit, with Cui Yanjin, military governor of Heyang and the three cities, as his deputy; Mi Xin, commander of the imperial cavalry bureau and military governor of Zhanghua, and Du Yangu, military observer of Shazhou, marched out from Xiongzhou. The middle column was commanded by Tian Chongjin, commander of the imperial infantry bureau and military governor of Jingnan, who moved out through Feihu. The western column, under the acting Grand Preceptor and military governor of Zhongwu, Pan Mei, together with Yang Ye, military observer of Yunzhou, went out through Yanmen Pass against Yun, Ying and Shuo. Liao matched Cao Bin's army with Yelü Xiuge, Resident Commissioner of the Southern Capital, put Yelü Shezhen in overall command against Pan Mei and the rest, and posted Linya Qinde with troops on the southern bank of Pingzhou as a reserve, while the Liao emperor and Empress Dowager Xiao led the central army, camped at Tuoluo Pass and east of Zhuozhou, in mutual support with the other columns. Both command systems had structural faults: the three Song columns belonged to different campaign headquarters and were not subordinate to one another, so the planned convergence depended on each army opening its own path, whereas on the Liao side the Resident Commissioner of the Southern Capital oversaw the southern front and the emperor and empress dowager sat in the centre with the generals, allowing the columns to hold each other on the same line.
people: 曹彬是這場戰役的主角，也是最大的敗將。他以天平軍節度使出任東路主將，三月癸酉與遼兵戰於固安南、克其城，繼而敗遼師於涿州東、乘勝攻下涿州北門，入城後遣部將李繼宣率輕騎渡涿河偵探敵情，擊退來犯之敵。遼將耶律休哥兵少不出戰，白日以精銳張其勢、夜裡遣輕騎掠單弱以脅餘眾，又設伏林莽、斷宋軍糧道；曹彬在涿州撐了十多天，糧食吃光，退兵至雄州。宋太宗聞報大驚，急令曹彬等待米信部到齊再出、與西路軍會合。曹彬部下諸將見潘美、田重進連克諸州，謀畫蜂起、更相矛盾，曹彬不能制，乃裹五十日糧再往攻涿州。遼聖宗駐涿州東五十里督戰，命耶律休哥與耶律蒲寧以輕兵薄南師，於是宋軍且行且戰凡四日始得至涿，時方炎暑、軍士疲乏、糧不繼，曹彬遂再棄涿州，令盧斌兼擁城中老幼由狼山南撤，大軍退時無復行伍，遂為耶律休哥所躡。岐溝關一戰宋軍大敗，曹彬收餘軍宵涉巨馬河、營於易水之南，李繼宣在巨馬河上力戰，遼兵始退，追奔至孤山。宮苑使王繼恩自易州馳騎至東京報信，才使宋太宗知道前線實況。知幽州行府事劉保勛馬陷淖中，其子劉利涉救之不能出，父子俱死。
peopleEn: Cao Bin was the central figure of the battle and its greatest loser. As military governor of Tianping he took command of the eastern column; in the third month he fought Liao troops south of Gu'an on the guiyou day and took the city, then beat a Liao army east of Zhuozhou, stormed the northern gate and entered the city, where he sent his subordinate Li Jixuan with light horse across the Zhuo river to scout, and drove off a Liao attack. The Liao general Yelü Xiuge, too few in number to fight, spent the day parading his elite to inflate his strength and the night sending light horse to harry the weak and wavering, while ambushing in the woods and cutting Song's supply line. Cao Bin held out at Zhuozhou for a little over ten days, ran out of food and withdrew to Xiongzhou. When the emperor heard of it he was greatly alarmed and ordered Cao Bin to wait for Mi Xin's column and link up with the western army. Cao Bin's officers, seeing Pan Mei and Tian Chongjin winning towns one after another, began plotting and contradicting one another; Cao Bin could not control them, and so packed fifty days of grain and marched again to attack Zhuozhou. The Liao emperor camped fifty li east of Zhuozhou to supervise the battle and ordered Yelü Xiuge and Yelü Puning to press the Song army with light troops. The Song fought and marched for four days before reaching Zhuozhou, at the height of the summer heat, with the soldiers exhausted and the grain running out; Cao Bin therefore abandoned Zhuozhou again, ordering Lu Bin to escort the old and young of the city south by Langshan. The army withdrew without order and was overhauled by Yelü Xiuge. At Qigou Pass the Song were badly beaten. Cao Bin gathered the remnants, crossed the Juma river by night and camped south of the Yi river, where Li Jixuan fought hard at the crossing until the Liao withdrew, the pursuit running as far as Gushan. The palace attendant Wang Ji'en rode the whole way from Yi prefecture to the eastern capital with the news, and only then did the emperor learn the true state of the front. Liu Baoxun, who administered the Youzhou office, was trapped in the mud when his horse foundered, and his son Liu Lishè could not pull him out; both father and son drowned.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩屬於弩機一系最原始也最有效的形制：弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發，連續射擊。戰國楚墓出土的銅弩機已具備完整的機牙、阻鐵與鉤弦部件，漢弩在此基礎上進一步分出步弩、蹶張弩與腰張弩。986 年戰場上真正能摸到的，是唐宋一路演化下來的弩具：宋軍以步弩列陣，張弦用蹶張之具，射程遠者稱神臂弓，力大而需以機關或足踏上弦，發射時一發一扣；野戰與守城還配備床子弩、拒馬、撞車、雲梯、飛石與葛炮一類攻守器械，弓弩箭矢是最大宗消耗。遼軍則以輕騎為骨幹，除環身刀、狼牙棒、標槍之外，皮兜索與套索用來勾倒敵將，拒馬與網索用來封路塞道，奔馳作戰全靠馬匹。卡面這件秦連弩本身並沒有出現在岐溝關的戰場上；它代表的是一種兵器觀念：把張弦的力量機械化，讓拉不滿硬弓的射手也能持續輸出，而守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。
kitsEn: The repeating crossbow on the card belongs to the oldest and most effective form of the crossbow trigger mechanism: the mechanism stores the draw force, and one tread of the foot releases one shot, allowing continuous fire. Bronze crossbow mechanisms unearthed from Chu tombs of the Warring States period already possessed complete trigger, catch and string-hook components, and Han crossbows branched from that base into the pedo-crossbow, the drawn-up crossbow and the waist-drawn crossbow. What could actually be handled on the field in 986 was the line of crossbows that had evolved through Tang and Song: the Song formed their foot crossbow lines, strung them with drawing devices, and the long-range pieces were called the divine-arm bow, powerful but requiring a mechanism or a foot tread to cock, one shot per trigger pull. Field and siege warfare also used the bed crossbow, cheval-de-frise, battering ram, siege ladder, stone-thrower and the so-called ge-pao siege engines, and bow and crossbow bolts were the bulk of the consumption. The Liao army rested on light cavalry; besides the curved sword, the wolf-toothed club and the javelin, they used leather pouches and lassos to pull down enemy officers, and cheval-de-frise and rope nets to block roads. The repeating crossbow on the card never appeared on the field at Qigou Pass itself; it stands for a view of weapons: mechanise the stored draw so that soldiers who cannot pull a heavy bow to full draw can keep up a steady rate of fire, while the defenders use the same idea to pin attackers outside the walls.
tactics: 宋軍的戰術是典型的強攻加急躁。曹彬先取固安，再破遼師於涿州東，然後入城屯駐，把派輕騎渡河偵探得來的捷報不斷送回京師；遼軍主力始終不與他正面決戰，只用夜襲、騷擾和斷糧拖他。第二次攻涿州時，宋軍士氣正盛，與遼騎且行且戰凡四日才退回城下，炎暑加糧秣不繼，士卒疲憊至極。撤退沒有接戰序列，各部互相超越，行伍散亂，人馬混雜，這正是遼軍騎兵最擅長收割的場面。耶律休哥的追擊不急著衝散宋軍前鋒，而是咬住殿後隊伍，把宋軍擠向拒馬河與巨馬河的水障；李繼宣在巨馬河上力戰才把追兵擋住，渡河時人畜互相踐踏，死者不計其數。遼軍的追擊也不急著一次吃掉宋軍，而是用輕騎輪番咬住殿後，迫其晝夜兼行，把一支精疲的隊伍拖成散兵。整場戰役的勝負不是由任何一次正面衝鋒決定，而是由糧道是否暢通、士卒還剩多少體力與行伍紀律是否還在決定。
tacticsEn: The Song tactics were a typical mixture of assault and impatience. Cao Bin took Gu'an first, beat a Liao army east of Zhuozhou, then garrisoned the city, sending back to the capital a stream of good news gathered by light horse scouting across the river; the main Liao force never fought him squarely, only using night attacks, harassment and the severing of his supply line to wear him down. On the second march against Zhuozhou the Song were still confident, fighting and marching for four days before falling back to the city, in the height of the summer heat, with the grain exhausted and the soldiers at the end of their strength. The retreat had no order of battle: units overtook one another, the formations came apart, men and horses were mixed together, and that was exactly the situation Liao cavalry were best at exploiting. Yelü Xioge did not rush the Song vanguard; he hung on the rear guard and pressed the withdrawing army towards the water barriers of the Juma and Juma rivers. Only Li Jixuan's hard fight at the crossing halted the pursuers, and in the confusion of the ford men and animals trod each other down, with a death toll beyond counting. The Liao pursuit was in no hurry to swallow the Song army whole; light horse took turns gnawing at the rearguard, forcing the column to march day and night and dragging an already spent formation into a mob of stragglers. The outcome of the whole battle was decided not by any single charge but by whether the supply line was open, how much stamina the soldiers had left, and whether the formations still held together.
data: 時間線相當清楚：雍熙三年正月宋太宗發動北伐，三月曹彬克固安、入涿州，四月宋軍自涿州敗退，五月庚午至岐溝關，遼兵追及，南師大敗。曹彬第二次出師時「裹五十日糧」，退回涿州時已是「糧不繼」；遼軍駐紮涿州東五十里，宋軍且行且戰凡四日始得至涿。戰後曹彬收殘部宵涉巨馬河，營於易水之南，追奔至孤山。傷亡與損失方面，《宋史》記餘眾奔高陽時為遼師衝擊，「死者數萬人，沙河為之不流，棄戈甲若丘陵」，耶律休哥收宋軍屍體堆成京觀。兵力數字在史籍間並不一致：宋太宗原計曹彬「以十餘萬眾聲言取幽州」，《宋史》與《續資治通鑑》對曹彬所部總人數只有十萬人級別的模糊記載，沒有可核的實數；遼軍方面，十一月起分三路南侵，君子館之戰中宋軍「死者數萬人」，可作同一戰役季的傷亡量級參照。時間上則極為緊逼：五月庚午一日之內自追擊到潰敗，當夜即宵涉巨馬河，翌晨已在易水之南宿營，追兵一直咬到孤山才罷，崩潰與潰退幾乎是連續發生的一件事。
dataEn: The timeline is fairly clear: in the first month of 986 the Song emperor launched the northern expedition; in the third month Cao Bin took Gu'an and entered Zhuozhou; in the fourth month the Song army was forced back from Zhuozhou; on the gengwu day of the fifth month it reached Qigou Pass, where the Liao caught up and the southern army was routed. On his second march out Cao Bin packed fifty days of grain, and by the time he was back at Zhuozhou the grain was already running out. The Liao camped fifty li east of Zhuozhou, and the Song army fought and marched for four days before it reached the city. After the defeat Cao Bin gathered the remnants, crossed the Juma river by night and camped south of the Yi river, with the pursuit running on to Gushan. On losses, the History of Song records that the stragglers who fled toward Gaoyang were struck by the Liao army, that tens of thousands died, that the Sha river was blocked so that it no longer flowed, and that the abandoned spears and armour lay like hills; Yelü Xioge gathered the Song dead to build a mound of trophies. Figures for the armies are not consistent between the sources: the emperor had planned that Cao Bin would advance with more than a hundred thousand men while professing to take Youzhou, and the History of Song and the Xu continuation of the Comprehensive Mirror give only vague statements at the level of hundreds of thousands, with no verifiable exact number. On the Liao side, three columns marched south from the eleventh month, and in the battle at Junziguan the Song lost tens of thousands, which serves as a comparable measure of losses in the same season of the same campaign. The timing is extremely tight: within a single day, on the gengwu day of the fifth month, the pursuit became a rout; the army crossed the Juma river that very night, and by the following morning it was camped south of the Yi river, the pursuers hanging on until Gushan before they stopped, so that the collapse and the retreat were very nearly one continuous event.
cause: 起因有兩層。表層是宋太宗想收復燕雲十六州：北宋先滅北漢，遼手里握著燕雲，兩國邊境自高梁河之戰後一直摩擦；982 年遼景宗去世、遼聖宗即位，知雄州事賀令圖、其父岳州刺史賀懷浦與文思使薛繼昭上書，說契丹主年幼、國事決於其母、韓德讓寵幸用事、國人上下離心，可以乘之。於是正月出兵，三路北伐。深層則是曹彬自己的戰術與管理：宋太宗叮囑他持重緩行、毋貪小利以要敵，指定他與潘美、田重進會合後再大軍制敵，曹彬卻因部下爭功、急於立功，孤軍冒進深入涿州，糧道被耶律休哥切斷，退回雄州後又傾全軍再攻涿州，把太宗交代的會戰部署全部打亂，也把自己的士氣和體力一併耗盡。出兵之前宋太宗在殿上定下的方案本是分兩步：西路先取雲、應、朔，幽州方向以十餘萬眾聲言取之，待田重進自飛狐、靈丘一帶東下再會合全師制敵。曹彬手上只有東路一路可用，卻要在敵前維持一個足以威脅幽州的姿態：兵多則糧重、兵少則聲勢不足，這一組矛盾從一開始就埋在他隊伍裡。
causeEn: There are two layers of cause. On the surface, the Song emperor wanted to recover the Sixteen Prefectures: Song had first destroyed Northern Han, Liao still held the prefectures, and the frontier between the two states had been rubbing since the battle of Gaoliang River. In 982 the Liao emperor Jingzong died and Shengzong took the throne; He Lingtu, administrator of Xiongzhou, his father He Huapu, governor of Yuezhou, and Xue Jizhao of the Directorate of Literary Works memorialised that the Liao ruler was young, that the government was in the hands of his mother, that Han Derang's favour dominated the court and that the Liao people were divided, and that the moment was worth seizing. So the expedition was launched in the first month in three columns. Beneath that lies Cao Bin's own method and management. The emperor had told him to hold firm, advance slowly, take no small advantage, and to join Pan Mei and Tian Chongjin before committing the full army. Cao Bin instead pressed on alone and deep into Zhuozhou because his officers competed for credit; his supply line was cut by Yelü Xiuge, and after falling back to Xiongzhou he turned the whole army once more against Zhuozhou, so that the deployment the emperor had ordered was thoroughly disrupted and the army's morale and stamina were spent at the same time. The plan the emperor had settled on before the expedition was two-stage: the western column was to take Yun, Ying and Shuo first, the Youzhou direction was to profess an advance with more than a hundred thousand men, and only after Tian Chongjin came down east from Feihu and Lingqiu would the whole army join for a decisive battle. Cao Bin had only the eastern column to work with, yet he had to maintain before the enemy a posture large enough to threaten Youzhou: too many men and the grain grew heavy, too few and the show of force failed. That contradiction was built into his army from the start.
impact: 岐溝關一役把雍熙北伐三路大軍半年來的所有進展一次性抹掉：新城、固安、涿州、飛狐、靈丘、蔚州、寰州、朔州、應州、雲州相繼放棄，北宋靠自身力量收復燕雲的嘗試就此告一段落。遼軍在沙河兩岸收宋軍屍體堆成京觀，耶律休哥因此封宋國王，耶律蒲寧、耶律壽寧等亦各受封賞，遼軍士氣大振；宋軍精銳喪失殆盡，士氣崩落，間接造成同年西路陳家谷口的慘敗與楊業殉國，也造成十一月至十二月君子館之戰中宋軍再遭重創、瀛州都部署劉廷讓所部全軍覆沒的結局。曹彬降右驍衛上將軍，其諸子更以通敵之罪被誅。從更長的視角看，986 年的失敗把宋遼力量對比推向對宋不利的一端，讓此後數十年雙方以北伐與反北伐反覆較勁，最終走向景德年間的澶淵之盟。遼軍隨即深入河北腹地，攻下深州、文安等城，河北平原上的前線自此不再由宋方掌握。
impactEn: Qigou Pass wiped out in a single stroke everything the three columns of the Yongxi expedition had won in half a year: Xincheng, Gu'an, Zhuozhou, Feihu, Lingqiu, Weizhou, Huanzhou, Shuozhou, Yingzhou and Yunzhou were all given up, and the attempt to recover the Sixteen Prefectures by Song's own strength came to an end. The Liao gathered the Song dead on both banks of the Sha river into a mound of trophies; Yelü Xiuge was made King of Song in reward, and Yelü Puning, Yelü Shouning and others received titles and rewards, while the Liao morale rose sharply. On the Song side the elite of the army was destroyed, morale collapsed, and this indirectly brought the defeat at Chanjiagu in the western column in the same year, in which Yang Ye died, and the disaster at Junziguan between the eleventh and twelfth months, when the entire command of Liu Tingrang, military governor of Yingzhou, was wiped out. Cao Bin was demoted to Right Xiaowei General, and his sons were later executed on a charge of communicating with the enemy. Seen from further back, the defeat of 986 pushed the balance of strength between Song and Liao against Song, and for the decades that followed the two states measured themselves through northern expeditions and counter-expeditions, until the road that led to the Chanyuan alliance in the Jingde era. The Liao then drove deep into the heart of Hebei, taking cities such as Shenzhou and Wen'an, and the front line across the Hebei plain was no longer held by Song.
result: 結果是宋軍大敗，戰役全勝歸遼。曹彬收整餘軍，連夜涉巨馬河，退到易水之南宿營，李繼宣在巨馬河上力戰才逼退追兵，一路追奔到孤山才罷；宋太宗在東京接到王繼恩的急報後，下詔諸將領兵分屯於邊，召曹彬、崔彥進、米信入朝，田重進率軍轉駐定州，潘美還代州，此前攻下的諸州一一退回。曹彬因此降右驍衛上將軍，數年後才復起為侍中、武寧軍節度使，去世後追封濟陽郡王、諡武惠，得以與趙普配享廟庭。五月之後，新城、固安、涿州等城相繼被放棄或失守，收復幽州的目標自此遙不可及；其後近二十年宋方再未組織過收復燕雲的北伐，直到景德元年真宗親征澶州才又在邊境上重開戰端。從裝備角度看，岐溝關沒有讓任何一件兵器擔下勝敗之責：連弩一系的守城火力在撤退與追擊的場面裡根本派不上用場，真正決定成敗的是糧道是否暢通、隊形是否還在、士卒還能不能拉開弓。
resultEn: The result was a complete Song defeat and a clear Liao victory. Cao Bin gathered what was left of the army, crossed the Juma river under cover of night and fell back to a camp south of the Yi river; only Li Jixuan's hard fight at the crossing forced the pursuers back, and the pursuit continued to Gushan before it stopped. When the report of Wang Ji'en reached the eastern capital, the Song emperor ordered the generals to station their troops separately along the frontier, summoned Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin and Mi Xin to court, moved Tian Chongjin's whole army back to Dingzhou and sent Pan Mei home to Daizhou; the towns taken earlier were given up one after another. Cao Bin was demoted to Right Xiaowei General and was not restored to high office for several years, being made Grand Preceptor and Military Governor of Wuning before his death in 999; he was posthumously given the title Prince of Jiyang, the posthumous name Wuhui, and was enshrined in the imperial temple alongside Zhao Pu. After the fifth month the cities of Xincheng, Gu'an and Zhuozhou were abandoned or lost in turn, and the aim of recovering Youzhou was suddenly out of reach; for nearly twenty years afterwards Song mounted no further northern expedition to recover the Sixteen Prefectures, and the next time the frontier flared was when the Chengzong emperor personally marched to Chanzhou in the Jingde era. From the point of view of equipment, no single weapon at Qigou Pass can be credited with the outcome: the defensive firepower of the crossbow family, the repeating mechanism included, was of no use in a retreat and a pursuit. What decided the fight was whether the supply line was open, whether the formations still held, and whether the soldiers could still draw their bows.
